out: sitelooper: the argument "On ticket RD-1015, remove both parts fwrd99-fm-n1 RD Part A and fwrd99-fm-n1 ..." contains "/bin/sh", which is what a shell makes of "$0" inside double quotes or an unquoted heredoc ($0 is the shell's own name), so "$0.00" arrives as "/bin/sh.00" and would be recorded into the flow. Put the text in single quotes, or pass it with --stdin / --instruction-file (a quoted heredoc: <<'EOF'). If the text really names that shell, add --allow-shell-path.
